# Five fix rounds do not satisfy the review. The item pauses with the findings as its question.
# Round 4 uses the fresh runner b. After the answer, round 6 reads it and the run ends.
exec obee run 7 &

# The run has opened the store once the first agent call is in the record.
waitfile calls.log
waitstatus 'paused: findings of review 5'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\trunning\tpaused: findings of review 5$'
! exists briefs/implement-6.txt

exec obee answer 7 keep the current API
wait
stdout 'item 7 finished after 6 fix rounds'

exec obee status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone$'

grep -count=1 '^implement 3 false a ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement 4 true b ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement 5 false b ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^implement 6 false b keep the current API$' calls.log
grep -count=7 '^review ' calls.log
grep 'answer=keep the current API' briefs/implement-6.txt

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- verdicts --
changes
changes
changes
changes
changes
changes
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
ready 7
release 7
